themes_negative: low CBR first-time pass rate (24%) inconsistent with review narrative
red_flags: Single-platform: all reviews are Google (via clickdrive); no klantenvertellen verified reviews, no Trustpilot/Trustoo/Facebook for this school
Uniform 5-star with no negative, mixed or lukewarm reviews at all
Many generic one-liners ('De sterkste school', 'Een geweldige en gerespecteerde professor', 'Hele goede rijschool, aanrader') with no specifics
Several reviews read like solicited well-wishes/blessings ('Moge God je een hele goede coach geven', 'veel succes en blijvend succes bij uw lessen') rather than service descriptions
Reviewer names cluster around one community; repeated 'in één keer geslaagd' narrative conflicts with the school's actual 24% first-time CBR pass rate
review_summary: Across ~16 readable Google reviews (4.9/5, ~94 total) students consistently praise instructor Halim ("professor Abdel Halim") as patient, professional and clear, with many claiming they passed first time and felt transformed into confident drivers. The corpus is uniformly 5-star with only a couple of specific reviews and many short generic or well-wish-style entries; there are no verified (klantenvertellen) reviews and the glowing first-time-pass claims sit uneasily next to the school's low 24% first-time CBR pass rate.
